method: Bemis-Murcko scaffold split; same RF family as serving endpoints

ames.split: Bemis-Murcko scaffold, disjoint train/cal/test (no shared scaffold)
ames.model: RandomForest(300, min_samples_leaf=2, class_weight=balanced) on Morgan1024+6 RDKit desc
ames.note: Realistic novel-chemistry generalization. This is the honest number for a triage tool; the leaked tdc_*_test.csv metrics are optimistic. The deployed model trains on all data, so production discrimination is typically >= these scaffold numbers.
